Message.Name: Seconds Timestamp Message
Message.Description: Provides information about the time of processing on the Trading Server to the nearest second. Always delivered at the time the information is generated, except for Reset and Communication Control. Only one tag is delivered per process and stored at the top of the first packet.

Field.Name: Time (Seconds)
Field.Description: Set to UNIX time (seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: Provides information about the status of trading on a per-issue basis. Delivered when there is a change in the tag.

Field.Name: Time (Microseconds)
Field.Description: Time to the nearest microsecond

Field.Name: Market Status
Field.Description: Indicates market status

Field.Name: Status Flag
Field.Description: Indicates trading status

Field.Name: Short Selling Status
Field.Description: Indicates application of the Short Selling Regulation

Field.Name: Pricing Method
Field.Description: Indicates method of pricing or status of quote display after the tag is delivered

Field.Name: Book Center Price
Field.Description: Set to the book center price while the Itayose method is in place or while a quote is displayed

Message.Name: Execution Summary Message
Message.Description: Provides summary information about execution. Delivered when an execution occurs.

Field.Name: Time (Microseconds)
Field.Description: Time to the nearest microsecond

Field.Name: Triggered Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side whose order triggered the execution

Field.Name: Total Volume
Field.Description: Total volume of executed orders in number of shares

Field.Name: Total Invalidation
Field.Description: Total volume of invalidated orders in number of shares

Field.Name: Last Price
Field.Description: Last price at the time the execution was processed

Field.Name: Match ID
Field.Description: Identifier assigned per issue on an execution basis, unique and sequential each business day

Field.Name: Best Offer
Field.Description: Best offer at the time the execution processing finishes; set to 0 at market close

Field.Name: Best Bid
Field.Description: Best bid at the time the execution processing finishes; set to 0 at market close

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: Provides information about book registration. Delivered when a new order or modification order is registered.

Field.Name: Time (Microseconds)
Field.Description: Time to the nearest microsecond

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Identifier assigned per issue on an order basis, unique and sequential each business day

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates buy or sell

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Order quantity registered on the order book in number of shares

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price registered on the order book; for market orders set to the maximum 64-bit value

Field.Name: Order Condition
Field.Description: Indicates the order condition

Field.Name: Modification Flag
Field.Description: When the A tag is generated by a modification order, indicates whether there is a change of time priority

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Provides information about registered orders in case of Zaraba execution. Delivered when an execution occurs in Zaraba.

Field.Name: Time (Microseconds)
Field.Description: Time to the nearest microsecond

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of the executed order; same Order ID may be set multiple times for partial executions

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates sell or buy

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Executed volume in number of shares

Field.Name: Match ID
Field.Description: Identifier assigned per issue on an execution basis, unique and sequential each business day

Message.Name: Order Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: Provides information about registered orders in case of Itayose execution. Delivered when an execution occurs by the Itayose method or while an SQ or STQ is displayed.

Field.Name: Time (Microseconds)
Field.Description: Time to the nearest microsecond

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of the executed order; same Order ID may be set multiple times for partial executions

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates sell or buy

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Executed volume in number of shares

Field.Name: Match ID
Field.Description: Identifier assigned per issue on an execution basis, unique and sequential each business day

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: Execution price

Field.Name: Adopted Pricing Method
Field.Description: Indicates the pricing method in place when the execution occurred

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: Provides information about order deletion from the order book. Delivered when an order is deleted via a cancel order or a modification order or when a registered order expires.

Field.Name: Time (Microseconds)
Field.Description: Time to the nearest microsecond

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Order ID of the cancelled order

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates sell or buy

Field.Name: Modification Flag
Field.Description: When the D tag was generated by a modification order, indicates whether there is a change of time priority

Message.Name: Reset Message
Message.Description: A tag requesting the resetting (i.e. cancellation) of all distributed information. When the user receives this tag, the user must clear all valid A tags.

Field.Name: Reset Start-End Flag
Field.Description: When TSE needs to reset all distributed data, this indicates the start or end of the process

Message.Name: Communication Control Message
Message.Description: Provides information about communication control. Delivered when communication starts and ends, and in between at minute intervals.

Field.Name: Test Mode Flag
Field.Description: Indicates production or test

Field.Name: Communication Start-End Flag
Field.Description: Indicates the start or end of communication

Value.Name: Short Selling Regulation is NOT applied
Cancel order or modification order that changes time priority
Modification order that does NOT change time priority
